scope: Implemented bootstrap, API and standalone-web inputs only. Worker and provider setup require their existing audited contracts; complete deployment automation is pending. The Postiz provisioner is retired: its database role and bootstrap password remain only so existing databases keep their history.

bootstrap.password_format: Six distinct, randomly generated 32-byte lowercase hex strings

api.social_provider: Post for Me is the only publisher and connection provider. Postiz is retired; its historical tables are kept read-only.
api.secret_boundary: No migration administrator, provisioner signing secret or paid model key on this service. Model calls (blog articles included) run on the worker through the skills harness; the only provider secrets read here are POSTFORME_API_KEY and PEXELS_API_KEY

web.secret_boundary: No database, SMTP, provider or OAuth credentials on this service
